title: Concept: Laravel Blade template error returned to a client
description: A Laravel Blade template error with its file and line in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The path names the framework and the exact view, which tells an attacker the stack and where the rendering happens.
applicability: Deployments that render a Laravel Blade template error with its file and line into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The path names the framework and the exact view, which tells an attacker the stack and where the rendering happens.
